sources.name: Visit Estes Park events calendar
sources.notes: Fetched 6 October 2026. Simpleview CMS destination site (the local marketing district, not the Town). /events/ redirects to /events-calendar/, with sub-listings /this-weekend/, /by-month/, /community-events/, /events-calendar/live-music/, seasonal pages (/winter-events/, /estes-park-skijor/, /frozen-dead-guy-days/) and /submit-event/. The RSS feed /event/rss/ was read once: application/rss+xml, 30 items; sample titles 'Pots and Paint', 'Bella Metz', 'Board Game Night at The Legion', 'Chocolate Bar Making Experience', 'Clay Class: Coil or Pebble Bowls', 'Intro to Stained Glass Workshop', 'Mini Clay Wheel Workshop', 'Morning Yoga'; item dates were all 'Mon, 05 Oct 2026 23:59:59 -0600' (Mountain time, apparently the event day rather than a publish time), so the feed looks like a rolling window of the next days' events, heavy on paid classes and recurring activities; locations were not shown by the helper's summary and need checking on first ingest. Not meetings. Not confirmed, 6 October 2026: the feed is the local marketing district’s listings calendar, which takes event submissions from businesses (/submit-event/), not an organizer’s own calendar. The official sources it would stand in for are the Town’s Events Division (eventsinestes-com, read by hand), the library (estesvalleylibrary-org) and the venues themselves.

Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3", DECISIONS.md, "Twenty-four sources turned on"): the feed is one robots.txt allows, so it is read under honor.
